description: This file contains unit tests for Telegram channel binding functions such as normalization and conversation matching, using the Vitest framework.

methods.name: normalizeTelegramAcpConversationId
methods.description: Normalizes a Telegram conversation ID, returning an object with conversationId and parentConversationId or null.

methods.name: matchTelegramAcpConversation
methods.description: Determines if a given conversation matches based on bindingConversationId, conversationId, and parentConversationId.

methods.name: resolveTelegramCommandConversation
methods.description: Resolves a conversation ID and parent ID based on threadId and originatingTo, preserving topics or handling direct commands.
